name: Entity Metrics
description: Record page views and downloads for entities on your Drupal site
project_description: Entity Metrics records node page views and media file downloads into a dedicated database table (entity_metrics_data), rate-limiting the recording endpoint per client IP. It can optionally enrich each recorded event with an approximate visitor location by reading a local MaxMind GeoLite2-City database on cron or from a Drush command; no visitor IP is ever sent to a remote lookup API. It ships two blocks (a per-node view-count block and a Leaflet map of visit locations), an admin settings form, and Drush commands to backfill geolocation and refresh the local database via the GeoIP Auto-Update dependency.
